title: OpenAI acquires NextSlide to support ChatGPT development
excerpt: NextSlide’s team, known for AI-driven presentation tools, will now contribute to the ongoing development of ChatGPT at OpenAI.
content_html:
Anwesha Pattanaik

Mon, August 10, 2026 at 4:34 AM CDT 2 min read

OpenAI has acquired the presentation technology startup NextSlide, integrating the company's team into the development of ChatGPT.

The acquisition was disclosed in a note by NextSlide founder Ahmed Beshry, who stated on LinkedIn that although the announcement is being made now, the transaction took place "earlier this year."

Financial terms of the deal have not been made public.

According to a statement on the NextSlide website, the company developed a product intended to convert prompts, notes, documents, or research into polished, editable presentations.

Beshry said: "Presentations help ideas move through the world. They teach, persuade, share research, and move important work forward. But creating a great presentation has traditionally required hours of work, design experience, or both."

Beshry explained that the team started NextSlide slightly more than a year ago, aiming to remove design barriers for presentation creation.

He added: "We built a product that could turn prompts, notes, documents, or research into a polished, editable presentation, making it easier for anyone to share what they know.

"Our goal was never simply to generate slides faster. We wanted to make visual communication more accessible and help more people express their ideas clearly."

Following the acquisition, Beshry said: "The NextSlide team is now at OpenAI, helping build ChatGPT. We're excited to continue pursuing that same mission: building AI products that help people create, communicate, and turn their ideas into meaningful work.

"To everyone who created a deck, shared feedback, or supported us along the way: thank you for helping shape NextSlide. We're grateful for the journey and excited for what comes next."

Last month, ReliaQuest partnered with OpenAI and joined the Daybreak Cyber Partner Program, which aims to speed up the adoption of artificial intelligence in enterprise cyber defence. Through the agreement, ReliaQuest will be able to collaborate technically with OpenAI and gain access to its cyber models.

"OpenAI acquires NextSlide to support ChatGPT development" was originally created and published by Verdict, a GlobalData owned brand.

content_html_zh:
安维莎·帕塔奈克

2026 年 8 月 10 日星期一凌晨 4:34 CDT 阅读时间 2 分钟

OpenAI 收购了演示技术初创公司 NextSlide，将该公司的团队整合到 ChatGPT 的开发中。

NextSlide 创始人艾哈迈德·贝什里 (Ahmed Beshry) 在一份说明中披露了此次收购，他在 LinkedIn 上表示，虽然现在才宣布这一消息，但交易是在“今年早些时候”进行的。

该交易的财务条款尚未公开。

根据 NextSlide 网站上的一份声明，该公司开发了一款产品，旨在将提示、笔记、文档或研究转换为精美的、可编辑的演示文稿。

贝什里说：“演讲有助于创意在全世界传播。 他们教授、说服、分享研究并推动重要工作向前发展。 但传统上，创建出色的演示文稿需要大量的工作和/或设计经验。”

Beshry 解释说，该团队在一年多前启动了 NextSlide，旨在消除演示文稿创建的设计障碍。

他补充道：“我们开发了一款产品，可以将提示、笔记、文档或研究转化为精美的、可编辑的演示文稿，使任何人都可以更轻松地分享他们所知道的内容。

“我们的目标从来不仅仅是更快地生成幻灯片。 我们希望让视觉传达变得更容易，帮助更多的人清楚地表达他们的想法。”

收购完成后，Beshry 表示：“NextSlide 团队现已加入 OpenAI，帮助构建 ChatGPT。 我们很高兴能够继续追求同样的使命：构建人工智能产品，帮助人们创造、交流并将他们的想法转化为有意义的工作。

“对于所有创建幻灯片、分享反馈或一路支持我们的人：感谢您帮助塑造 NextSlide。 我们对这段旅程心存感激，并对接下来的事情感到兴奋。”

上个月，ReliaQuest 与 OpenAI 合作，加入 Daybreak Cyber​​ 合作伙伴计划，该计划旨在加速人工智能在企业网络防御中的采用。 通过该协议，ReliaQuest 将能够与 OpenAI 进行技术合作并获得其网络模型的访问权限。

《OpenAI 收购 NextSlide 以支持 ChatGPT 开发》最初由 GlobalData 旗下品牌 Verdict 创建和发布。
